stories.headline: Who is Scott Colom, Mississippi’s first Black senator in 150 years?
stories.summary: Mississippi is home to a large Black American population but no Black person has held a Senate seat since the 1800s.

stories.now: BBC News: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate. NPR: In a state that hasn't had a Democrat in office since 1980 and hasn't sent a Black Senator to Washington since the 1870s, Colom's win represents a massive upset in state politics.

stories.now: The Guardian: Meeting comes after CEO admitted to having a relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy Business live – latest updates Nvidia’s board of directors met on Wednesday to decide whether to oust Jensen… BBC News: The billionaire tech executive's future is in question after reports of a second extramarital affair.
stories.backstory: Huang co-founded Nvidia and has run it since 1993, building it into the main supplier of the chips used to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems and one of the world's most valuable companies. Earlier this week, reports said the company had opened an internal investigation into whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort through a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly passed information to Beijing. Huang told staff in a company email that he had been unfaithful in his marriage. The stock had already slipped on that first report before Wednesday's news.
